title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: one cover in force per booking
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs how many covers a customer may hold and when a new cover may be quoted for a booking. It applies whenever a cover is to be quoted for a shipment.

## Policy clause

1. A customer may hold any number of covers, one for each shipment; the product sets no limit on the number of covers one customer holds.
2. Each booking has at most one cover in force. A cover is in force while it is quoted, active, in the open-claim state or in the closed-claim state.
3. A new cover for a booking is quoted only when the earlier cover on that booking was cancelled or has expired.
4. Moving a shipment from statutory liability (AHL Standard Carrier Liability) to a CargoCare product therefore means cancelling the quoted statutory record before the new quote is made, which is possible only while the statutory record is still quoted.
5. The check rests on the system records of the covers held on the same booking and their status, read before the new quote is made; it does not rest on the customer's account of the shipment.

## Decision table: may a new cover be quoted for this booking?

| Status of the cover already on the booking | Counts as in force | New quote for the booking |
|---|---|---|
| Quoted | Yes | Not made |
| Active | Yes | Not made |
| Open claim | Yes | Not made |
| Closed claim | Yes | Not made |
| Cancelled | No | May be made |
| Expired | No | May be made |

A booking on which no cover is recorded has no cover in force, so the one-cover limit does not stand in the way of a quote.

## Hypothetical cases

- **Case A (hypothetical):** a shipper holds covers on three different bookings and asks for a cover on a fourth booking that carries no cover. The number of covers held is not limited, and the fourth booking has no cover in force, so the quote is not barred by this policy.
- **Case B (hypothetical):** a booking carries the statutory record in the quoted state, and the shipper wants a CargoCare product instead. The statutory record is cancelled first, and only then is the CargoCare quote made.
- **Case C (hypothetical):** the statutory record on a booking is already active. The move to a CargoCare product is not possible, because cancelling the statutory record is possible only while it is still quoted.

## Points of judgement

**Does a cover in the closed-claim state still block a new quote?** Yes. The closed-claim state is one of the four in-force states.
